attachments.insertion_landmark: tongue body (fanning out from apex to base) and hyoid body

actions: protrudes and depresses the tongue (its most inferior fibers)

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Largest of the extrinsic tongue muscles; forms the bulk of the tongue body. Clinically important as the main muscle preventing posterior tongue collapse/airway obstruction during sleep (its weakness/hypotonia is implicated in obstructive sleep apnea).
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
